what_is_unchanged: Everything in metadata/h6_step2_724.json (as amended on 5 November 2026) other than its reading rule: the candidate (s3c-ann-net) and its walk, the 18:00 decision instant, the strata and their membership (coupon flag read as #849 does), the benchmarks, the one declared variant sc_s3c_ann_net_riskscale with its k grid, window and labels, the target-day series, the splits, seed 724, 10,000 draws, mean block 3 events, HAC lag 3, two-sided 90% studentized stationary bootstrap. The variant count is 1. scripts/h6_step2_1492.py reuses scripts/h6_step2_724.py's run unchanged and replaces only the paired test and the reading. The panel is the published panel built at 18:00 from the tracked fixtures; the walk is the development walk of scripts/capped_baselines_b2star_1434.py

what_changes.reading_rule: Every reading (the kill rule on the union without the bill stratum, the same reading by regime and by pressure-day type, and the variant rule) is taken from the lower end of the studentized 90% interval on mean(d), d = S(benchmark) - S(model), positive favouring the model (her ruling on #1009, 20 October 2026; pattern of docs/research/s3-terms-1243-result.md), not from the skill interval. Skill and its interval are shown beside it on every row. #724's declaration fixed the skill interval (its reading_rules); this declaration replaces that reading by her ruling of 6 November 2026 and nothing else in the rule
what_changes.fallback: A pair whose skill is undefined (the benchmark scores zero on a resample) keeps its mean(d) bound (#1215): it is retried on the same seed, block and lag with skill left out. A pair whose mean(d) bound fails because some resample has no long-run variance is read once more from the same seed with those resamples dropped and counted (#1239), exactly as spread_mr_variants_761.run_pairs does, with the event block and lag of #1131 instead of the pooled defaults. A pair stays undefined only when the series itself has no long-run variance or every resample has none, with the reason
what_changes.defined_rows_unchanged: a row defined in #724's record is recomputed on the same pair, seed, block and lag and must equal it; the run refuses to write otherwise (ValueError). Only the rows #724 left undefined can gain a bound
what_changes.lens_c_caveat: shown on the page: the HAC standard error that studentizes the bound is understated about 2x after 2020 (Lens C, #958; measured for the daily lag-10 series, not for this event series at lag 3), so an interval that excludes zero is narrower than it should be and a reading is evidence for a question

comparison: the page lists every row that #724's record defines whose skill-interval lower end and mean-d lower end fall on opposite sides of zero, with both intervals and the direction of the change, every row #724 left undefined that now has a bound, and the readings that move (kill rule, by regime and pressure-day type, variant rule). The count of each goes in result.json

reading_rules.development_not_a_verdict: every reading is a development reading on days already seen. Under scoring protocol v1 only prospective confirmation days give a verdict
reading_rules.row_reading: gain if the lower end of the mean-d interval is above zero, loss if its upper end is below zero, undecided otherwise, no reading where the row is thin, identical or has no bound
reading_rules.kill_rule: (s3c-ann-net) shows skill on the union without the bill stratum if the lower end of its mean-d interval is above zero against B1 and against B2 both; otherwise it shows none that this data can show. B1', the #693 calendar benchmark and B2*-cap do not decide
reading_rules.variant_rule: the variant adds skill over (s3c-ann-net) on the union without the bill stratum if the lower end of the mean-d interval of the paired difference against the candidate is above zero
reading_rules.twCRPS: read the same way; a disagreement between grid CRPS and twCRPS is reported, not resolved

not_ruled.pressure_day_type_rows: the pressure-day-type rows bootstrap each group's own days, as #724 did, not the studentized domain interval she ruled for H5 day-type rows (#1454). Whether that ruling also covers H6 pages is hers (the issue says so); this re-run does not change it and the page says so. Question with a default in the pull request
not_ruled.no_multiplicity_correction: no multiplicity correction on reported cuts (default 7 of #1131); the variant count is 1

limits: as metadata/h6_step2_724.json: a development measurement of one frozen candidate and one declared variant on 2020-04-03 to 2025-12-31, on days seen before. The strata overlap; the union counts a day once. The HAC caveat above applies to every bound. No day of 2026 is scored
